title: Story pack: myth or fact, the Creative diversity column
hook: Myth or fact: Ads Manager now has a column for creative diversity.
caption:
Story pack (no feed caption).

One myth-or-fact question about Meta ads. Frame 2 is the quiz. Frame 3 gives the answer and where to look. Frame 4 shows how one brand's score moved. Frame 5 asks people to check their own account.
alt_text: Five vertical story frames. Frame 1: Myth or fact, Meta ads edition. Frame 2 quiz: Ads Manager now has a column for creative diversity. Frame 3: fact, the column began appearing in late August 2026 and reached most accounts in the last week of October. Frame 4: one brand's creative diversity score went from 63 to 92 out of 100, two months after the changes Galvor recommended. Frame 5: check yours today.
cta: Answer the quiz; check the column in your own account
